checks.title: Handshake outputs are 0 while reset is asserted; no transfer while i_rst_n=0
checks.behavior: At every rising and every falling edge of i_clk at which i_rst_n=0: o_s_axi_awready=0, o_s_axi_wready=0, o_s_axi_arready=0, o_s_axi_bvalid=0 and o_s_axi_rvalid=0, whatever the values of i_s_axi_awvalid, i_s_axi_wvalid, i_s_axi_arvalid, i_s_axi_bready and i_s_axi_rready. As a result, the checker's transfer detector (valid=1 and ready=1 and i_rst_n=1 at a rising edge) records no AW, W, AR, B or R transfer at any rising edge where i_rst_n=0.

checks.title: Data outputs and o_regs are 0 while reset is asserted
checks.behavior: At every rising and every falling edge of i_clk at which i_rst_n=0: o_s_axi_bresp=2'b00, o_s_axi_rresp=2'b00, o_s_axi_rdata=32'h0000_0000, and every bit of o_regs (all LPARA_REGS_W=PARA_NUM_REGS*32 bits) is 0.

checks.title: No transfer at R1
checks.behavior: At edge R1 (the first rising edge of i_clk at which i_rst_n=1 after a period with i_rst_n=0), the sampled values (cycle ending at R1) of o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready, o_s_axi_arready, o_s_axi_bvalid and o_s_axi_rvalid are all 0, so no AW, W, AR, B or R transfer occurs at R1 whatever the valid and ready inputs.

checks.title: Readies are 1 from R1
checks.behavior: If i_rst_n stays 1 from R1 through edge R1+1, then at edge R1+1 the sampled values (cycle starting at R1) of o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready are all 1.

checks.title: o_s_axi_awready follows the held-write-address state
checks.behavior: Checker state aw_held: set at a rising edge with an AW transfer (i_s_axi_awvalid=1, o_s_axi_awready=1, i_rst_n=1); cleared at the rising edge of the B transfer of that transaction (o_s_axi_bvalid=1, i_s_axi_bready=1, i_rst_n=1) and whenever i_rst_n=0. At every rising edge n >= R1+1 (most recent R1, i_rst_n=1 at every edge since R1): if aw_held was 0 in the cycle ending at n then sampled o_s_axi_awready=1, whatever the value of i_s_axi_awvalid; if aw_held was 1 then sampled o_s_axi_awready=0. As a result, after an AW transfer at Ea no other AW transfer occurs at any edge up to and including Eb, and o_s_axi_awready is 1 again at edge Eb+1 (cycle after the B transfer).

checks.title: o_s_axi_wready follows the held-write-data state
checks.behavior: Checker state w_held: set at a rising edge with a W transfer (i_s_axi_wvalid=1, o_s_axi_wready=1, i_rst_n=1); cleared at the rising edge of the B transfer of that transaction and whenever i_rst_n=0. At every rising edge n >= R1+1: if w_held was 0 in the cycle ending at n then sampled o_s_axi_wready=1, whatever i_s_axi_wvalid; if w_held was 1 then sampled o_s_axi_wready=0. Hence no other W transfer occurs at any edge up to and including Eb, and o_s_axi_wready is 1 at edge Eb+1.

checks.title: o_s_axi_bvalid is exactly predicted: 1 from Ec until Eb, otherwise 0
checks.behavior: Ec is the rising edge at which the later of the AW and W transfers of a write transaction occurs (the same edge if both occur together). Checker state b_pending: set at Ec, cleared at the B transfer edge Eb (o_s_axi_bvalid=1 and i_s_axi_bready=1 at a rising edge with i_rst_n=1) and whenever i_rst_n=0. At every rising edge n >= R1+1, sampled o_s_axi_bvalid equals b_pending as of the cycle ending at n. Therefore o_s_axi_bvalid=1 at edge Ec+1 (latency exactly 1 cycle), it is 0 at every edge before both AW and W are taken, it is 0 at edge Eb+1, exactly one B transfer occurs per transaction that reaches Ec, and no B response appears after R1 for a transaction that was in progress when i_rst_n was asserted.

checks.title: B response held stable under back-pressure
checks.behavior: If at a rising edge o_s_axi_bvalid=1, i_s_axi_bready=0 and i_rst_n=1, and i_rst_n stays 1 until the next rising edge, then at the next rising edge o_s_axi_bvalid=1 and o_s_axi_bresp equals its value at the previous edge. Holds for any number of consecutive cycles.

checks.title: o_s_axi_bresp never EXOKAY or DECERR
checks.behavior: At every rising edge with i_rst_n=1 and o_s_axi_bvalid=1: o_s_axi_bresp is 2'b00 or 2'b10 (never 2'b01, never 2'b11).

checks.title: o_s_axi_bresp matches the decode of the address taken at Ea
checks.behavior: Decode of the i_s_axi_awaddr value taken at Ea: word index w = awaddr[PARA_ADDR_W-1:2]; mapped if w < PARA_NUM_REGS (read/write register w) or w == 16 (status); otherwise unmapped (includes w = PARA_NUM_REGS..15, 17..31 and any 1 in bits 7..PARA_ADDR_W-1). At every rising edge with i_rst_n=1 and o_s_axi_bvalid=1: o_s_axi_bresp=2'b00 if the transaction's address is mapped, 2'b10 if unmapped, independent of i_s_axi_wstrb (including 4'b0000), awaddr[1:0] and i_s_axi_awprot. o_s_axi_bresp is not compared when o_s_axi_bvalid=0 and i_rst_n=1.

checks.title: o_s_axi_arready follows the held-read-address state
checks.behavior: Checker state ar_held: set at a rising edge with an AR transfer (i_s_axi_arvalid=1, o_s_axi_arready=1, i_rst_n=1); cleared at the R transfer edge Er (o_s_axi_rvalid=1, i_s_axi_rready=1, i_rst_n=1) and whenever i_rst_n=0. At every rising edge n >= R1+1: if ar_held was 0 in the cycle ending at n then sampled o_s_axi_arready=1 whatever i_s_axi_arvalid; if ar_held was 1 then sampled o_s_axi_arready=0. Hence no other AR transfer occurs at any edge up to and including Er, and o_s_axi_arready=1 at edge Er+1.

checks.title: o_s_axi_rvalid is exactly predicted: 1 from Ear until Er, otherwise 0
checks.behavior: Checker state r_pending: set at the AR transfer edge Ear, cleared at Er and whenever i_rst_n=0. At every rising edge n >= R1+1, sampled o_s_axi_rvalid equals r_pending as of the cycle ending at n. Therefore o_s_axi_rvalid=1 at edge Ear+1 (latency exactly 1 cycle), 0 at edge Er+1, exactly one R transfer per AR transfer, and no R response after R1 for a read in progress when i_rst_n was asserted.

checks.title: R response held stable under back-pressure
checks.behavior: If at a rising edge o_s_axi_rvalid=1, i_s_axi_rready=0 and i_rst_n=1, and i_rst_n stays 1 until the next rising edge, then at the next rising edge o_s_axi_rvalid=1 and o_s_axi_rdata and o_s_axi_rresp equal their values at the previous edge, regardless of changes of i_status or o_regs in between. Holds for any number of cycles.

checks.title: o_s_axi_rresp never EXOKAY or DECERR
checks.behavior: At every rising edge with i_rst_n=1 and o_s_axi_rvalid=1: o_s_axi_rresp is 2'b00 or 2'b10.

checks.title: Read data and response match the value sampled at Ear
checks.behavior: At Ear the checker decodes the i_s_axi_araddr value taken at Ear (w = araddr[PARA_ADDR_W-1:2]) and captures the expected data: if w < PARA_NUM_REGS, expected rdata = o_regs[32w+31:32w] sampled in the cycle ending at Ear (old value if a write to w has Ec at the same edge), rresp=2'b00; if w == 16, expected rdata = i_status sampled in the cycle ending at Ear, rresp=2'b00; otherwise expected rdata=32'h0000_0000, rresp=2'b10. At every rising edge from Ear+1 to Er with i_rst_n=1 and o_s_axi_rvalid=1, o_s_axi_rdata and o_s_axi_rresp equal the expected values. Independent of write activity, araddr[1:0] and i_s_axi_arprot. o_s_axi_rdata/o_s_axi_rresp are not compared when o_s_axi_rvalid=0 and i_rst_n=1.

checks.title: o_regs equals the reference register model every cycle
checks.behavior: Reference model M (PARA_NUM_REGS x 32 bits): all 0 whenever i_rst_n=0; at each edge Ec of a write transaction whose awaddr taken at Ea has word index k < PARA_NUM_REGS, for each lane i (0..3) with i_s_axi_wstrb[i]=1 as taken at Ew, M[32k+8i+7:32k+8i] <= i_s_axi_wdata[8i+7:8i] as taken at Ew; no other update (writes to status or unmapped addresses, wstrb=4'b0000, reads, and transactions discarded by reset change nothing). Check: at every rising edge with i_rst_n=1 after the first reset and at every falling edge of i_clk, o_regs equals M as updated at the most recent preceding rising edge (new value visible in the cycle starting at Ec, sampled at Ec+1 and later; unchanged at Ec and before).

checks.title: Outputs change only at a rising edge of i_clk or at reset assertion
checks.behavior: Monitor value changes of o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready, o_s_axi_bvalid, o_s_axi_bresp, o_s_axi_arready, o_s_axi_rvalid, o_s_axi_rdata, o_s_axi_rresp and o_regs. Every change must occur in the same simulation time step as a 0->1 transition of i_clk, or in the time step of a 1->0 transition of i_rst_n (or while i_rst_n=0). Any change at another time (e.g. following an input change at a falling edge of i_clk) is a failure.

checks.title: Power-on reset and post-reset idle state
checks.behavior: Checks reset from time zero, reset values, readiness from R1, and idle response channels after release.
checks.stimulus: Drive i_rst_n=0 from time zero (before the first rising edge of i_clk) for 3 cycles with all valids, i_s_axi_bready and i_s_axi_rready at 0 and i_status=32'h1234_5678. Release i_rst_n to 1 synchronously to i_clk (shortly after a rising edge). Keep all valids 0 for 5 cycles with i_s_axi_bready=i_s_axi_rready=1. Then read each byte address 0x00+4k (k=0..PARA_NUM_REGS-1) and 0x40 with i_s_axi_rready=1.
checks.expected: While i_rst_n=0 every output is 0 (o_regs all 0). At R1 the sampled readies, o_s_axi_bvalid and o_s_axi_rvalid are 0. At edges R1+1..R1+5: o_s_axi_awready=o_s_axi_wready=o_s_axi_arready=1, o_s_axi_bvalid=o_s_axi_rvalid=0. Each register read gives o_s_axi_rvalid=1 at Ear+1 with o_s_axi_rdata=32'h0000_0000 and o_s_axi_rresp=2'b00; the 0x40 read returns 32'h1234_5678, rresp 2'b00. No output checks before the first assertion of i_rst_n.

checks.title: Asynchronous reset assertion mid-cycle with transactions in progress
checks.behavior: Every output takes its reset value when i_rst_n falls, without waiting for a rising edge of i_clk.
checks.stimulus: After reset, write nonzero distinct values to all registers. Then (a) complete a write to REG_0 with i_s_axi_bready=0 so the B response is pending, and complete a read of REG_1 with i_s_axi_rready=0 so the R response is pending; assert i_rst_n=0 at 1/4 clock period after a rising edge. Hold 2 cycles, release synchronously. (b) Repeat with only an AW transfer taken (W not presented) and assert i_rst_n=0 at 3/4 period after a rising edge.
checks.expected: In the same time step as (or immediately after) the 1->0 transition of i_rst_n, and before the next rising edge of i_clk: o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready, o_s_axi_arready, o_s_axi_bvalid, o_s_axi_rvalid = 0; o_s_axi_bresp=2'b00, o_s_axi_rresp=2'b00, o_s_axi_rdata=0; o_regs = all 0.

checks.title: Reset discards held write address, held write data and pending responses
checks.behavior: Held and pending state is discarded by reset; no B or R response and no register write occur after release for a transaction in progress at reset.
checks.stimulus: (a) AW only: present AW to 0x04 (one transfer), keep i_s_axi_wvalid=0; once o_s_axi_awready=0, assert reset 2 cycles, release; keep valids 0 for 6 cycles after R1 with i_s_axi_bready=1; then present only W (wdata=32'hDEAD_BEEF, wstrb=4'b1111) for 8 cycles; then present AW to 0x08. (b) W only: W transfer (wdata=32'h5555_AAAA, wstrb=4'b1111) without AW; reset; after release present only AW to 0x0C for 8 cycles (wvalid=0), then present W with wdata=32'h0F0F_0F0F. (c) B pending: complete a write of 32'h1111_1111 to 0x00 with i_s_axi_bready=0; reset; after release i_s_axi_bready=1 for 6 cycles. (d) R pending: complete an AR to 0x00 with i_s_axi_rready=0; reset; after release i_s_axi_rready=1 for 6 cycles.
checks.expected: (a) After R1: o_s_axi_bvalid=0 for the 6 idle cycles, readies=1, o_regs=0; the lone W is taken at the first edge it is presented (o_s_axi_wready=0 from the next cycle), o_s_axi_bvalid stays 0 for the 8 cycles and o_regs stays 0 (no write to 0x04); the AW to 0x08 is taken at the next edge (Ec), bvalid=1 at Ec+1 with bresp 2'b00, REG_2=32'hDEAD_BEEF from Ec+1 (when PARA_NUM_REGS>2), REG_1 stays 0. (b) Symmetrical: bvalid stays 0 and o_regs stays 0 until the new W; then REG_3=32'h0F0F_0F0F (when PARA_NUM_REGS>3), not 32'h5555_AAAA. (c) o_s_axi_bvalid stays 0 after R1; o_regs=0. (d) o_s_axi_rvalid stays 0 after R1. In all cases o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready, o_s_axi_arready=1 from R1.

checks.title: Valids held at 1 through reset become new requests after R1
checks.behavior: Valids during reset have no effect; a valid held through reset is taken at R1+1 as a new request with the payload present then.
checks.stimulus: During a 3-cycle reset drive i_s_axi_awvalid=i_s_axi_wvalid=i_s_axi_arvalid=1, i_s_axi_bready=i_s_axi_rready=1, i_s_axi_awaddr=i_s_axi_araddr=0x08 (0x00 when PARA_NUM_REGS<3), wstrb=4'b1111, first wdata=32'h0BAD_F00D then change wdata to 32'hCAFE_F00D during reset. Keep valids at 1 through release and afterward with the same payload for at least 4 more cycles.
checks.expected: No transfer at any edge with i_rst_n=0 nor at R1; o_regs stays 0 through R1+1. AW, W and AR transfers all occur at R1+1. At R1+2: o_s_axi_bvalid=1, o_s_axi_bresp=2'b00; target register = 32'hCAFE_F00D on o_regs; o_s_axi_rvalid=1 with o_s_axi_rdata=32'h0000_0000 (old value, Ear=Ec) and o_s_axi_rresp=2'b00; readies sampled 0. B and R transfers at R1+2; readies 1 at R1+3 and the next AW/W/AR transfers occur at R1+3.

checks.title: Write address/data ordering: AW first, W first, same edge
checks.behavior: AW and W are accepted in any order; register written and response given only after both, one cycle after the later.
checks.stimulus: With i_s_axi_bready=1, write distinct values to mapped registers using: (1) AW at edge E, W at E+1; (2) AW at E, W at E+5; (3) W at E, AW at E+1; (4) W at E, AW at E+5; (5) AW and W at the same edge E. After each channel's transfer, drive different values on its payload (awaddr to another mapped address, wdata/wstrb to other values) while waiting for the other channel.
checks.expected: Ec = the later transfer edge (E for case 5). The first-taken channel's ready is sampled 0 from its transfer edge+1 through Eb; the other ready stays 1 until its transfer. o_s_axi_bvalid=0 at every edge <= Ec and 1 at Ec+1; B transfer at Ec+1; both readies 1 at Ec+2. The register selected by the awaddr taken at Ea changes once, from Ec+1, to the wdata/wstrb taken at Ew; the post-transfer payload changes have no effect. bresp=2'b00.

checks.title: All 16 write-strobe values with byte-distinct data
checks.behavior: Byte lane i of the selected register is written only when i_s_axi_wstrb[i]=1, with wdata taken at Ew.
checks.stimulus: For s = 4'b0000 to 4'b1111, target register k = s mod PARA_NUM_REGS: first write 32'h3C5A_96C3 + s with wstrb=4'b1111 (old value V); then write D = ~V (every byte differs) with i_s_axi_wstrb=s; change wdata/wstrb immediately after the W transfer; then read the register at 0x00+4k.
checks.expected: After the strobed write, o_regs[32k+31:32k] lane i equals D lane i if s[i]=1 and V lane i if s[i]=0, from Ec+1; all other o_regs bits unchanged; bresp=2'b00 for every s including 4'b0000 (where the register stays V). The read returns the same value with rresp=2'b00.

checks.title: Register map and aliasing: unique values in every register, full address sweep
checks.behavior: Exactly PARA_NUM_REGS read/write registers at 0x00+4k plus the status register at 0x40 are mapped; every other word index of the PARA_ADDR_W-bit address space is unmapped; no aliasing.
checks.stimulus: Set i_status=32'h5747_A7A5. Write REG_k at 0x00+4k with the unique value 32'hA500_0000 | (k<<16) | (k<<8) | (8'hFF-k), wstrb=4'b1111, for k=0..PARA_NUM_REGS-1. Then read every word address 4w for w=0..2^(PARA_ADDR_W-2)-1 with i_s_axi_rready=1.
checks.expected: o_regs[32k+31:32k] holds its unique value for every k. Reads of w<PARA_NUM_REGS return that register's unique value with rresp=2'b00; w=16 returns 32'h5747_A7A5 with rresp=2'b00; every other w returns 32'h0000_0000 with rresp=2'b10. Exactly PARA_NUM_REGS+1 word indices answer OKAY. o_regs unchanged by the reads.

checks.title: Status register: sampling at Ear, hold under back-pressure, writes ignored
checks.behavior: A status read returns i_status from the cycle ending at Ear, held until Er; writes to status change nothing and answer OKAY.
checks.stimulus: Change i_status at every falling edge of i_clk (counter pattern, distinct each cycle). Read 0x40 with i_s_axi_rready=1, then read 0x40, 0x41, 0x42, 0x43 with i_s_axi_rready held 0 for 5 cycles after o_s_axi_rvalid rises. Write 0x40 with data 32'hFFFF_FFFF and wstrb 4'b0000, 4'b0001, 4'b1010, 4'b1111 (bready=1), then read 0x40 again.
checks.expected: Each status read: o_s_axi_rvalid=1 at Ear+1, o_s_axi_rdata = i_status value in the cycle ending at Ear (not the Ear-1 or Ear+1 value), stable until Er despite i_status changes, rresp=2'b00. Each status write: bvalid at Ec+1, bresp=2'b00, o_regs unchanged. The later read returns the current i_status at its Ear.

checks.title: Unmapped addresses: SLVERR, rdata 0, no register change, normal timing
checks.behavior: Writes and reads of unmapped addresses answer SLVERR with the normal 1-cycle latency, reads return 0, writes change no register.
checks.stimulus: Write every register with a known nonzero value. Then, for each address A in: 4w for w=PARA_NUM_REGS..15; 0x44; 2^PARA_ADDR_W-4; and, when PARA_ADDR_W>7, M | (1<<j) for every mapped address M (0x00+4k, 0x40) and every j in 7..PARA_ADDR_W-1: write A with wdata=32'hFFFF_FFFF, wstrb=4'b1111 (bready=1), then read A (rready=1). In CFG-BASE this covers 0x20 to 0x3C.
checks.expected: Each write: o_s_axi_bvalid=1 at Ec+1, bresp=2'b10, o_regs unchanged. Each read: o_s_axi_rvalid=1 at Ear+1, rdata=32'h0000_0000, rresp=2'b10. Readies 1 again the cycle after each B/R transfer.

checks.title: Unmapped access does not stall or disturb other channels or the next transaction
checks.behavior: After an unmapped access, the next transaction behaves as after a mapped one; concurrent channels are unaffected.
checks.stimulus: With awvalid/wvalid/bready held 1, issue an unmapped write (0x44) followed back-to-back by a mapped write to 0x00; simultaneously run back-to-back reads of 0x04 (or 0x00 if PARA_NUM_REGS=1) with arvalid/rready held 1. Then issue an unmapped read (0x44) followed by a mapped read of 0x00 while back-to-back writes run. Compare with the same sequence using only mapped addresses.
checks.expected: Unmapped write AW/W at n, B at n+1 (SLVERR), mapped write AW/W at n+2, B at n+3 (OKAY), register updated from n+3. Read stream transfers occur at exactly the same edges and with the same data as in the all-mapped run. Symmetrically for the unmapped read; write stream timing and o_regs unchanged.

checks.title: Address bits [1:0] and AxPROT have no effect
checks.behavior: Outputs are identical whether addr[1:0] and prot are zero or random.
checks.stimulus: Run a seeded random sequence of at least 200 reads and writes over mapped and unmapped word addresses with random valid/ready timing, i_status pattern and wstrb, with addr[1:0]=2'b00 and awprot=arprot=3'b000 (run A). Assert reset, then rerun the same sequence with random addr[1:0] per transaction and random 3-bit i_s_axi_awprot/i_s_axi_arprot values (run B), all else identical.
checks.expected: Every output of run B equals run A cycle for cycle (relative to R1). Mapped addresses with addr[1:0]!=2'b00 answer OKAY and access the aligned word given by addr[PARA_ADDR_W-1:2]; no SLVERR caused by addr[1:0] or prot.

checks.title: B channel back-pressure and blocking of new AW/W
checks.behavior: Write response is kept pending for any bready delay; no new AW or W is taken until the edge after Eb.
checks.stimulus: Perform writes with i_s_axi_bready: (a) at 1 before o_s_axi_bvalid rises (delay 0); (b) rising 1 cycle after bvalid; (c) rising 6 cycles after bvalid; (d) driven as a function of o_s_axi_bvalid. During every hold-back present new AW and W valids (different mapped address and data).
checks.expected: o_s_axi_bvalid=1 with constant bresp from Ec+1 through Eb, where Eb is the first rising edge with i_s_axi_bready=1 (Eb=Ec+1 in (a)). The new AW and W are not taken at any edge <= Eb (awready=wready=0) and are taken at Eb+1; the new register value appears from Eb+2; no o_regs change during hold-back.

checks.title: R channel back-pressure and blocking of new AR
checks.behavior: Read data is kept pending and stable for any rready delay; no new AR taken until the edge after Er.
checks.stimulus: Perform reads of a mapped register with i_s_axi_rready: at 1 before o_s_axi_rvalid rises; rising 1 cycle after; rising 6 cycles after; dependent on rvalid. During hold-back present a new AR (other address) and write a new value to the register being read.
checks.expected: o_s_axi_rvalid=1 with constant rdata/rresp from Ear+1 through Er (first edge with i_s_axi_rready=1); rdata is the value at Ear, not the newly written value. The new AR is not taken at any edge <= Er and is taken at Er+1, with rvalid at Er+2.

checks.title: Back-to-back throughput, writes and reads alone and together
checks.behavior: One write and one read every 2 cycles under continuous valids/readies, unaffected by each other.
checks.stimulus: (a) Hold i_s_axi_awvalid, i_s_axi_wvalid, i_s_axi_bready at 1 for 20 writes with addresses cycling through mapped registers and new data each transfer. (b) Hold i_s_axi_arvalid, i_s_axi_rready at 1 for 20 reads. (c) Run (a) and (b) at the same time.
checks.expected: Writes: AW and W transfers at edges n, n+2, n+4, ...; B transfers at n+1, n+3, ...; 20 writes complete in 40 cycles; awready/wready alternate 1,0. Reads: AR at m, m+2, ...; R at m+1, m+3, .... In (c) the transfer edges of each channel are identical to (a) and (b) alone; read data follows CHK-015.

checks.title: Concurrent read and write of the same register around Ec
checks.behavior: A read samples the register at Ear: old value for Ear <= Ec, new value for Ear > Ec, never a byte mix.
checks.stimulus: Register k holds 32'h1122_3344. Write 32'hAABB_CCDD with wstrb=4'b1111 completing at Ec=E. Read k with (1) Ear=E-1 and i_s_axi_rready held 0 until E+2; (2) Ear=E; (3) Ear=E+1. Repeat with register k reset to old value between cases. Also run a write of register a and a read of register b (a!=b, when PARA_NUM_REGS>1) with transfers at the same edges.
checks.expected: (1) rdata=32'h1122_3344, stable through Er despite the write at E. (2) rdata=32'h1122_3344. (3) rdata=32'hAABB_CCDD. All rresp=2'b00; never a mix of bytes of the two values. Different-register case: read returns register b's value, register a updated at Ec, both with 1-cycle response latency; responses answered in order of Ec/Ear.

checks.title: Back-pressure on one direction does not stall the other
checks.behavior: B back-pressure does not affect AR/R; R back-pressure does not affect AW/W/B or o_regs.
checks.stimulus: (a) Complete a write and hold i_s_axi_bready=0 for 20 cycles while issuing 5 back-to-back reads of mapped registers with i_s_axi_rready=1. (b) Complete a read and hold i_s_axi_rready=0 for 20 cycles while issuing 5 back-to-back writes with i_s_axi_bready=1.
checks.expected: (a) AR transfers at m, m+2, ..., R transfers at m+1, m+3, ...; o_s_axi_arready and rdata identical to a run without the pending write. (b) Writes complete every 2 cycles (AW/W at n, B at n+1), o_regs updates from each Ec+1, while o_s_axi_arready=0 and o_s_axi_rvalid=1 with constant rdata.

checks.title: No combinational input-to-output path; readies do not wait for valids
checks.behavior: Outputs change only at rising edges; readies depend only on held state.
checks.stimulus: With i_rst_n=1, in idle and in each state (AW held, W held, B pending, R pending), toggle every input (all valids, i_s_axi_bready, i_s_axi_rready, addresses, prot, wdata, wstrb, i_status) at each falling edge of i_clk and again at 3/4 period; sample all outputs right after each change and just before the next rising edge. Also keep all valids at 0 for 10 cycles after R1.
checks.expected: No output changes between rising edges. In idle with valids at 0, o_s_axi_awready=o_s_axi_wready=o_s_axi_arready=1 every cycle; ready values follow CHK-005/006/011 independent of the valids.

checks.title: CFG-MIN map (PARA_NUM_REGS=1, PARA_ADDR_W=7)
checks.behavior: Smallest configuration: only REG_0 and STATUS mapped in a 0x00-0x7F space.
checks.stimulus: Run in CFG-MIN. Check o_regs width. Write and read every word address 0x00..0x7C (wdata=32'hFFFF_FFFF, wstrb=4'b1111), set i_status to a known value.
checks.expected: o_regs is 32 bits. 0x00 answers OKAY and holds 32'hFFFF_FFFF; 0x40 read returns i_status with OKAY and write answers OKAY; 0x04..0x3C and 0x44..0x7C answer SLVERR, read 0, no o_regs change.

checks.title: PARA_NUM_REGS=16 map (CFG-FULL-A7, also CFG-MAX)
checks.behavior: Full bank: no unmapped address below 0x44.
checks.stimulus: Run in CFG-FULL-A7 (PARA_NUM_REGS=16, PARA_ADDR_W=7). Check o_regs width. Write unique values to 0x00..0x3C, read back 0x00..0x7C.
checks.expected: o_regs is 512 bits; 0x00..0x3C are REG_0..REG_15 with OKAY and their unique values on o_regs[32k+31:32k]; 0x40 is STATUS (OKAY); only 0x44..0x7C answer SLVERR with rdata 0.

checks.title: PARA_ADDR_W=16 high-bit decode (CFG-MAX)
checks.behavior: Any 1 in address bits 15..7 makes the address unmapped (no aliasing).
checks.stimulus: Run in CFG-MAX. Write unique values to all 16 registers. Write (wdata=32'hFFFF_FFFF, wstrb=4'b1111) and read 0x0080, 0x0100, 0x8040, 0xFFFC, and every mapped address (0x00+4k, 0x40) with a single bit j set for j=7..15.
checks.expected: All these accesses answer SLVERR (bresp/rresp=2'b10), reads return 0, o_regs unchanged; subsequent reads of 0x00+4k return the unique values with OKAY.

assumptions: Sampling convention: assertion values at 'edge n' are the values in the cycle ending at edge n (sampled just before the rising edge of i_clk); a value required 'from edge n' is checked at edge n+1 and later.

Event names follow the spec terms: Ea/Ew = edges of the AW/W transfers, Ec = the later of Ea and Ew, Eb = B transfer edge, Ear = AR transfer edge, Er = R transfer edge, R1 = first rising edge with i_rst_n=1 after the most recent reset.
Decode used by the checkers: word index w = addr[PARA_ADDR_W-1:2]; w < PARA_NUM_REGS selects REG_w, w == 16 selects STATUS, every other w is unmapped.
All checkers are disabled before the first assertion of i_rst_n and reset all their tracking state whenever i_rst_n=0.
The simulator is 2-state (Verilator), so X/Z on inputs is prevented by the testbench and not checked.
CHK-017 is done by monitoring value changes on the outputs and comparing their simulation time with i_clk rising-edge times and i_rst_n falling-edge times.
